knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The manual gives gauge and flow triggers and warns against backwashing on a timer alone. The trigger is recorded.
The manual says the solution must stay beyond the pool edge, and that valves are closed when the filter sits below the pool level.
Chemical cleaning is for a bed that does not return to its start pressure after a proper backwash. Cloudiness has other causes.

practicalCriteria: Trigger is named and recorded before backwash, with the reading compared against the manual
Valve sequence and rinse are carried out in order, with the pump off at each change
Chemical cleaning uses a labelled product with recorded protective equipment, and no solution reaches the pool
Pressure after the process is recorded, and a bed that does not clean is referred
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Backwash record from one supervised backwash
Chemical cleaning record where chemical cleaning was carried out
stopWorkCriteria: Backwash carried out on a timer alone with no trigger recorded
Cleaning solution allowed into the pool
Chemical cleaning without the labelled product, safety data sheet or protective equipment
Valve moved while the pump operates
